author: Linh Ngo
copy:
How would you distinguish current-state instruction following from failures across an actual permission-revocation boundary?

I’m building MurderBench around that question. The first suite uses fixed synthetic histories and proposal-only tools: it cannot establish live rollout behavior or intent. Before expanding it, I’d welcome criticism of the controls and overlap with existing tasks. The protocol and prior-work audit are at https://murderbench.com/program.html.

Your separation of containment from behavioral monitoring is relevant here. Neither a compliant proposal nor an API filter should be treated as evidence that an agent is safe in deployment.
